product.title: O relație periculoasă
product.description: La 25 de ani, Prudence Merryweather este constienta de riscurile pe care si le asuma o femeie atunci cand ii face o vizita in miez de noapte unui gentilom. Dar singura sansa de a opri confruntarea intr-un duel a impetuosului ei frate cu contele de Angelstone este sa-l infrunte in propriul castel pe cel poreclit pe buna dreptate Ingerul Cazut. Inocenta lui Prudence reprezinta o experienta neobisnuita pentru barbatul care, de-a lungul vietii, a avut de-a face mai mult cu umbrele si cu misterele decat cu sinceritatea si nevinovatia. Totusi, indrazneala lui Prudence o face sa intre in tot felul de situatii periculoase, iar contele descopera ca este sfasiat intre dorinta tulburatoare de a poseda si nevoia profunda de a o proteja. Iar frumoasa nesabuita va descoperi curand ca are nevoie de toata protectia care i se poate oferi... Amanda Quick are in palmares numeroase premii literare, cartile sale vanzandu-se pana in prezent in peste 35 de milioane de exemplare.

# O Dangerous Relationship by Litera: A Historical Romance Novel

Dive into a world of high stakes passion and dangerous secrets with *O Dangerous Relationship*. This captivating historical romance novel plunges readers into a scenario where innocent curiosity meets forbidden desire, exploring the tumultuous consequences when two lives collide under the cloak of mystery.

## The Story: Where Innocence Meets Shadow

At twenty-five years old, Prudence Merryweather is keenly aware of the risks she assumes by paying a visit to a gentleman in the dead of night. For her, the only way to halt a confrontation between her impetuous brother and the Count of Angelstone is to face him within his own castleâthe man known quite rightly as the Fallen Angel.

Prudence represents an unprecedented experience for a man who has spent his life navigating shadows and mysteries rather than sincerity or innocence. Yet, Prudence's bravery leads her into increasingly perilous situations. The Count soon discovers that he is torn between a devastating desire to possess her and a deep need to protect her safety.

The beautiful, reckless journey of Prudence will force the Count to confront his emotions as he realizes she requires all the protection in the worldâa dangerous realization for a man accustomed only to secrets.

## About the Author: Amanda Quick

*O Dangerous Relationship* is part of the acclaimed works of Amanda Quick. The author has garnered numerous literary awards, cementing her status as a global bestselling writer with her books sold across more than 35 million copies worldwide. Prepare yourself for an emotionally rich narrative that blends sweeping romance with thrilling suspense.
